store.0: Finance strategy: Long-term, asymmetric upside, capital preservation. Portfolio: equities, private equity, bonds, real estate, alternatives. Time management: 5:30 AM markets review, workout, decisions. Saturdays: plan, evaluate Pioneer Tech pre-seed. Sundays: family, reading.
store.1: Success = discipline + adaptability + relationships. Discipline gets you started; adaptability keeps you ahead; relationships drive your growth. Every major opportunity stems from a nurtured connection.
store.2: Success isn't about talent—it's about resilience. Setbacks are tuition, not failure. Losing the Intelligent Motors deal crushed me, but my mentor's words changed everything: 'You'll lose more than you win—make sure your wins are bigger than your losses.' Now I view rejection as growth.
store.3: Create your own luck. Don’t wait for perfect conditions—proactively reach out. Simple questions to industry leaders opened doors I never would have accessed. Opportunity finds those who show up.
store.4: Bet on yourself. No one gives you opportunities. You must make yourself undeniable. Act like a leader before you have the title. Think like an investor, operate like a CEO. Opportunities catch up.
store.5: Success is about what you sustain. Good decisions, risk management, and humility drive long-term growth. Short-term wins breed complacency. The moment you think you’ve made it, you stop growing. Growth is the only true indicator of lasting success.
